_comment: Example config for J2K Vision. Copy to ../j2k_config.json (the canonical runtime config) and edit.
_warning: Do NOT commit personal values (ps5_ip, psn_user, custom calibration) back to the repo.
_timing_comment: Conservative baseline timing — adjust per shot profile in-game. Default values are intentionally MID range (not aggressive) so first-run users do NOT see persistent TIMING LATE/EARLY.
